findings.issue: Unicode/emoji icons used instead of SVG icons — poor contrast and inconsistent rendering across platforms
findings.impact: Accessibility: emoji icons have inconsistent rendering and may not be announced by screen readers consistently
findings.fix: Migrate Unicode icons to lucide-react SVG icons with proper aria-hidden and aria-label attributes

findings.issue: Loading state shows text 'Loading...' instead of skeleton component — inconsistent with rest of app
findings.impact: Poor user experience during loading — no visual placeholder for layout structure
findings.fix: Replace 'Loading...' text with Skeleton component matching workspace layout structure

findings.issue: Focus not returned to hamburger button after closing mobile sidebar via overlay click or Escape
findings.impact: Keyboard users lose context after closing sidebar — focus jumps to unexpected location
findings.fix: Store reference to trigger element and call .focus() after sidebar close

findings.issue: Create workspace trigger uses role='button' on a div with tabIndex=0 instead of native <button>
findings.impact: Not keyboard accessible in all browsers; no native button semantics (Space key may not activate)

findings.issue: Channel list items (Link elements inside role='listbox') lack aria-label identifying them as navigation items
findings.impact: Screen reader users cannot distinguish channel links from other list items
findings.fix: Add aria-label='Navigate to channel {channel.name}' on each channel Link element

findings.issue: Theme toggle button in app header may lack aria-label — ThemeToggle component from @chat/ui needs verification
findings.impact: Screen reader users may not know the theme toggle button's purpose
findings.fix: Ensure ThemeToggle component accepts and propagates aria-label prop

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help menu — bulk actions require mouse
findings.impact: Power users cannot learn keyboard shortcuts; no documented shortcut reference
findings.fix: Add Ctrl+/ or ? keyboard shortcut help overlay; document common shortcuts

findings.impact: Screen reader pronunciation may be wrong for non-English content
findings.fix: Add next-intl or similar i18n library; make lang attribute dynamic

findings.issue: Search results use aria-selected but do not set aria-activedescendant on the search input
findings.impact: Screen reader cursor tracking is imprecise during keyboard navigation of search results
findings.fix: Set aria-activedescendant on the search input pointing to the currently highlighted result
